caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned facing forward. The chair has a wooden backrest, which is irregularly shaped and predominantly brown with patches of faded green paint and visible wood grain. The seat of the chair is flat, also brown in color, and shows signs of wear with a few prominent cracks and a missing section near the front edge. Both armrests are attached to slender vertical supports; the left armrest shows signs of significant decay and damage, while the right armrest is slightly more intact but still worn. The legs of the chair are similarly brown, with the front right leg noticeably more angular and the front left leg showing signs of weathering and discoloration. The chair has a simple construction, with joints and connections visible on the front. The drawing is contained within a thin rectangular border centered on a cream-colored page. The artist’s signature appears near the bottom left of the rectangle. The composition is plain, with the chair centered and no other objects or background elements present.
title: Sleigh Chair
